title.hr: Buka kroz snimateljski dan: doza se zbraja
title.en: Noise over a shooting day: the dose adds up

concept.hr: Svaka 3 dB udvostruče energiju: kratki glasni događaji pune dnevnu dozu
concept.en: Every 3 dB doubles the energy: short loud events fill the daily dose

summary.hr: Dan od blokova buke: agregat, ventilator i ćorci pune dnevnu dozu; štitnici, skidanje štitnika i udaljenost od agregata.
summary.en: A day built from noisy blocks: generator, wind machine and blanks fill the daily dose; defenders, lifting them off, and distance.
